facts.fact: 接待台坐着一个近乎透明的幻灵，只能对 Daniel 和 Lucy 发出树叶般的沙沙声与拍翅般的挥手。
facts.anchor: the rustling-leaves noises the nearly transparent apparition seated at the reception desk is making at us now

facts.fact: Daniel 抱怨 Executives 总在跟 Accounts Receivable 开会，并质问那到底是什么部门。
facts.anchor: What the hell even is Accounts Receivable?

facts.fact: Daniel 说带活人进 Executive Suite 不只是「不寻常」，而是「前所未有」。
facts.anchor: It’s not just unusual. It’s unprecedented. But so is this situation.

facts.fact: Lucy 在接待台上看见了自己的 Death Card，以及她当初亲手签下的延长寿命合同。
facts.anchor: my now-familiar Death Card—and the contract I originally signed to extend my life

facts.fact: 会议室主位两侧坐着两个几乎像人又不完全像人的长袍者，加上 CEO 一共三位 Executives。
facts.anchor: Two robed people who look almost, but not quite, human sit at either side of the table’s head in midnight-black chairs.

facts.fact: Lucy 展示的第一张照片是她和舞伴 Aidan Hsu 在毕业舞会上的正式合照。
facts.anchor: the horrific professional picture of me with my date, Aidan Hsu, at our senior prom

facts.fact: Lucy 用姐姐拍下她吐后照这件事，讲出「拿在乎的人开玩笑是表达爱的方式」。
facts.anchor: Teasing people we care about can be a way of showing affection

facts.fact: 结尾她对 CEO 说，Executives 对人类的了解少到无法理解自己人为什么会爱上一个人。
facts.anchor: that you don’t even understand why one of your own fell for one
